verdicts.reason: A drops the sea photo entirely, which hurts fidelity, and mixes alignments: the logo and button are centred while the headline and body copy are left-aligned. The button also sits a little close to the bottom edge, but the headline, copy and CTA read in a clear order and fill the tall canvas well. B shrinks the sea image to a meaningless sliver at the bottom edge and pins the logo top-right while the text sits left, leaving a large dead blue gap between the copy block and the centred button, so the layout looks top-heavy and unplanned.
